implementation_summary: Chat integration for the A2UI protocol (spec §2.5/§4/§5). Wire types: src/a2ui/types.ts (A2uiEnvelope = {version} & opaque payload, A2uiActionEnvelope {version, action:{name,surfaceId,sourceComponentId?,context?}}, A2uiDataModel); StreamChunk.a2ui, ChatMessage.a2uiEnvelopes (assistant) + a2uiAction/a2uiDataModel (user), HistoryItemBackend mirrors, ChatRequest a2uiSupportedCatalogs/a2uiAction/a2uiDataModel. Stream: chatGeneration._handleChunk grows historyItem.a2uiEnvelopes in arrival order (terminal `last` chunk carrying an envelope still closes the stream). History: chatHelpers BE→FE maps a2uiEnvelopes (assistant item) and a2uiAction/a2uiDataModel (user item) with null defaults. Renderer glue: src/a2ui/useA2uiSurface.ts replays the envelope array through a FRESH MessageProcessor(createA2uiCatalog(), actionHandler, {version:'v0.9.1'}) memoized on array identity — idempotent replay for streaming snapshots; envelopes are structuredClone-d because valtio snapshots are frozen while the SDK DataModel mutates the updateDataModel value in place; pre-filters unknown component types (findUnsupportedComponentType in src/a2ui/envelopes.ts, registry-decoupled so the store can import the module) and converts processor rejections into an error flag; actionHandler receives {name,surfaceId,sourceComponentId,context,dataModel} with dataModel read directly from surface.dataModel.get('/') because MessageProcessor.getClientDataModel() only reports surfaces with sendDataModel:true, which the backend's createSurface never sets. UI: ChatA2uiBlock renders every surface via A2uiSurface inside InteractiveErrorBoundary with A2uiFallback for unsupported/rejected envelopes and a busy-guard on submit; ChatAiMessage renders it when a2uiEnvelopes is non-empty, else the legacy ChatAiInteractiveBlock (old path untouched). Submit: store.submitA2uiAction(surfaceId, actionName, sourceComponentId, dataModel, displayText, replaceHistoryIndex?) builds the v0.9.1 action envelope, attributes the turn to the assistant owning the surface (envelopesContainSurface over history, tail fallback), sends a2uiAction+a2uiDataModel in the regular chat request with optimistic chip; _handleRequestError rollback extended to a2uiAction turns (chip turn removed + toast). Capability: _prepareRequestData unconditionally injects a2uiSupportedCatalogs:[CATALOG_ID] into every assistant chat request body (workflow execution endpoints excluded — different request model, not gated). Display text: src/a2ui/displayText.ts buildA2uiDisplayText joins top-level data-model fields as 'field: value · …' (numbers/booleans/primitive arrays; empty strings and nested objects skipped; 60-char truncation), falls back to the humanized action name, then 'Submitted'. Config: A2UI_PROTOCOL_VERSION bumped 'v0.9'→'v0.9.1' to match backend WIRE_VERSION (manifest test updated).
